defmodule MyAppWeb.ProxyController do use MyAppWeb, :controller alias MyApp.Cache alias MyAppWeb.ContentSanitizer @trusted_origins ["https://cdn.myapp.com", "https://assets.myapp.com"] @max_redirect_depth 3 # Handles requests forwarded by nginx reverse proxy # nginx sets X-Original-URI and X-Forwarded-Proto headers def proxy_content(conn, params) do with {:ok, origin} <- validate_origin(conn), {:ok, content_path} <- extract_content_path(conn, params), {:ok, cached} <- fetch_or_cache(content_path, origin) do conn |> put_resp_content_type(cached.content_type) |> put_resp_header("x-content-origin", origin) |> send_resp(200, render_content(cached, conn)) else {:error, :invalid_origin} -> conn |> send_resp(403, "Forbidden") {:error, :not_found} -> conn |> send_resp(404, "Not Found") {:error, _reason} -> conn |> send_resp(500, "Internal Error") end end defp validate_origin(conn) do origin = get_req_header(conn, "x-forwarded-host") |> List.first() || "" scheme = get_req_header(conn, "x-forwarded-proto") |> List.first() || "https" full_origin = "#{scheme}://#{origin}" if full_origin in @trusted_origins do {:ok, full_origin} else {:error, :invalid_origin} end end defp extract_content_path(conn, params) do # The reverse proxy passes the original URI in a header original_uri = get_req_header(conn, "x-original-uri") |> List.first() || "" path_segment = params["path"] || "" # Normalize path: decode URI components for cache lookup normalized = URI.decode(original_uri) |> Path.expand() case normalized do "/content/" <> rest -> {:ok, rest} _ -> {:ok, path_segment} end end defp fetch_or_cache(path, origin) do cache_key = :crypto.hash(:sha256, "#{origin}:#{path}") |> Base.encode16() case Cache.get(cache_key) do nil -> case load_content(path) do {:ok, content} -> Cache.put(cache_key, content, ttl: 300) {:ok, content} error -> error end cached -> {:ok, cached} end end defp load_content(path) do # Simulates loading content from internal service {:ok, %{body: "
